title: E-Commerce SEO & Organic Growth Campaign
summary: Technical SEO overhaul and content strategy that grew organic traffic for a multi-category online retailer.
overview: The client's product pages ranked poorly against competitors despite a larger catalog. Site speed issues, thin category content, and a messy internal linking structure were quietly capping organic growth.
approach: Ran a full technical SEO audit covering crawlability, Core Web Vitals, and duplicate content across 400+ product pages.
Rebuilt category page templates with unique, keyword-researched content and improved internal linking.
Fixed site speed issues (image compression, lazy loading) that were hurting mobile Core Web Vitals scores.
Built a content calendar targeting mid-funnel keywords to capture buyers earlier in the research phase.
findings: Found 120+ product pages with duplicate meta descriptions, diluting ranking signals across the catalog.
Identified a crawl budget issue where bots were spending 40% of their time on filtered/faceted URLs.
Mobile page speed was costing an estimated 15% of potential organic conversions before fixes.

title: Google & Meta Ads Management for SaaS Startup
summary: Full-funnel paid acquisition strategy balancing Google Search, Display, and Meta retargeting for a B2B SaaS product.
overview: A fast-growing SaaS startup was spending heavily on broad-match Google Ads with no retargeting strategy, resulting in high CAC and low trial-to-paid conversion visibility.
approach: Restructured Google Ads campaigns into tightly themed ad groups with negative keyword lists to cut wasted spend.
Launched Meta retargeting campaigns targeting site visitors and trial sign-ups who hadn't converted.
Built conversion tracking in GA4 and Google Ads to tie ad spend directly to trial-to-paid conversions.
Ran structured A/B tests on ad creative and landing pages to improve click-through and conversion rates.
findings: Discovered 35% of ad spend was going to broad-match searches unrelated to the product's actual use case.
Found trial sign-ups from Meta retargeting converted to paid at 2.3x the rate of cold traffic.
Identified a landing page form with 6 fields causing a 40% drop-off versus a shorter 3-field version.

title: Social Media Growth Strategy for D2C Brand
summary: Organic content strategy and community management program that grew a direct-to-consumer brand's social following and engagement.
overview: A growing D2C brand had inconsistent posting, no content pillars, and flat engagement despite steady follower growth — the account looked active but wasn't driving traffic or sales.
approach: Developed content pillars aligned with brand voice and audience interests, replacing ad hoc posting.
Built a 90-day content calendar across Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest with a consistent posting cadence.
Introduced a community management workflow for responding to comments and DMs within set SLAs.
Ran monthly content audits using platform analytics to double down on top-performing formats.
findings: Identified short-form video content outperformed static posts by 4x on engagement rate.
Found inconsistent posting times were suppressing reach during the brand's highest-traffic hours.
Surfaced that user-generated content drove higher save/share rates than branded product shots.

title: Email Marketing Automation & ROI Dashboard
summary: A Klaviyo automation build-out paired with a reporting pipeline that turns campaign data into stakeholder-ready dashboards.
overview: Stakeholders wanted a clear weekly view of email performance, but the team was manually pulling numbers from Klaviyo into spreadsheets every Friday — taking hours and prone to copy-paste errors.
approach: Built core Klaviyo flows: welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, and win-back campaigns.
Set up list segmentation based on purchase behavior and engagement recency for targeted sends.
Built a Looker Studio dashboard pulling Klaviyo and Shopify data automatically, replacing manual exports.
Added a 'campaign health' color legend (Green/Amber/Red) tied to open rate, click rate, and revenue per send.
findings: Eliminated 3+ hours of manual reporting work per week for the marketing team.
Surfaced that the abandoned cart flow was driving 18% of total email revenue with minimal effort.
Standardized how 'campaign health' was communicated to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Content Marketing & SEO Blog Strategy
summary: An editorial content system that turned a dormant company blog into a consistent lead-generation channel.
overview: The client's blog had published sporadically for years with no keyword strategy, generating almost no organic traffic or leads despite a backlog of decent-quality articles.
approach: Audited existing content and identified which posts to refresh, consolidate, or retire based on search intent and traffic potential.
Built a keyword-mapped content calendar targeting buyer-intent and informational search terms.
Produced long-form guides with embedded lead magnets (templates, checklists) to capture email sign-ups.
Set up internal linking and content clusters around pillar pages to strengthen topical authority.
findings: Found 60% of existing posts had no target keyword at all, explaining the flat traffic.
Identified three high-intent topics competitors weren't covering well, creating a quick-win opportunity.
Refreshing five outdated posts recovered more traffic in month one than publishing five new ones.

title: Analytics & Conversion Funnel Optimization
summary: A GA4 and conversion-tracking overhaul paired with structured A/B testing to lift conversion rate across the purchase funnel.
overview: The client had migrated to GA4 but tracking was incomplete, so the team was making funnel decisions on incomplete data and hadn't run a structured experiment in over a year.
approach: Rebuilt GA4 event tracking and Google Tag Manager setup to capture the full purchase funnel accurately.
Used Hotjar session recordings and heatmaps to identify friction points in the checkout flow.
Ran a prioritized A/B testing roadmap targeting the highest-drop-off steps first.
Built a funnel dashboard giving stakeholders real-time visibility into conversion rate by step.
findings: Found 30% of 'add to cart' events were never firing correctly, undercounting true funnel volume.
Identified the shipping cost reveal step as the single largest drop-off point in the funnel.
A single-page checkout variant outperformed the multi-step original by 23% in conversion rate.
